title: SIM-GRAPH: A universal guide to symmetric interactions
summary: Symmetry plays a central role throughout physics, from Fourier analysis on discrete lattices to the classification of elementary particles in the standard model. In finite quantum systems, symmetries are often discrete, such as reflection and rotational symmetries. Here, we present the SIM-GRAPH method (Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians), which uses such symmetries to efficiently calculate ground-state observables of interacting quantum systems.
